data.name: Muman
data.gender_notes: Muman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'amana' which means 'to trust'. The name Muman signifies a tranquil and restful soul, one who inspires trust and confidence in those around them. The name Muman carries the meaning “Tranquil, Restful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muman usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquil, restful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying trust and tranquility in Allah.
data.etymology: Muman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tranquil, Restful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muman total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مومن
in_arabic.meaning: مومن کا مطلب ہے جس جو ایمان لاتا ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: مومن (Muman) کا نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'وہ شخص جو ایمان لاتا ہے' یا 'جس کے دل میں ایمان ہے'۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر شدہ صفت 'مؤمن' سے ماخوذ ہے، جو ایمان اور صدقے کی علامت ہے۔ مومن وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو اللہ پر یقین رکھتا ہے اور اس کے حکم کا پیروی کرتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: مومن
in_urdu.meaning: مومن کا مطلب ہے جو اللہ پر ایمان لاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مومن (Muman) کا نام عربی جڑوں سے بنا ہے، جو 'مؤمن' (Mu'min) سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'اللہ پر ایمان لانے والا'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ مومن وہ شخص ہے جو اللہ کی وحدانیت پر یقین رکھتا ہے اور اس کے تمام حکموں کی پیروی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुमन
in_hindi.meaning: मुमन का अर्थ है जो अल्लाह पर विश्वास करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुमन (Muman) नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है 'वह व्यक्ति जो अल्लाह पर विश्वास करता है'। यह नाम कुरआन में वर्णित 'मु'मिन' (Mu'min) की विशेषता से लिया गया है, जो विश्वास और सच्चाई का प्रतीक है। मुमन वह व्यक्ति होता है जो अल्लाह पर विश्वास करता है और उसकी आज्ञा का पालन करता है।

in_english.name: Muman
in_english.meaning: Muman means one who brings faith or believes in Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Muman originates from Arabic, derived from 'mu'min' (مؤمن), meaning 'one who believes' or 'faithful'. This term is mentioned in the Quran as a characteristic of those who have faith in Allah. A mu'min is someone who believes in the oneness of Allah and follows His commandments. The name signifies faith, trust, and spiritual commitment in Islamic tradition.

data.spiritual_significance: Furthermore, the name Muman reflects the spiritual aspect of having a strong sense of faith and reliance on God. In the Quran, it is written, "And put your trust in God, and enough is God as a Disposer of affairs" (Quran 33:3). Thus, Muman, the trustworthy one, represents an individual who embodies strong faith and trust in God, which is essential for spiritual growth.
